name: PlayTime
summary: Tracks game play time on Knulli.

notes: Experimental TrimUI Smart Pro test package; no minimum Knulli version or package-specific device result is claimed.
The manager restores execute permission only for the reviewed playtime binary and playtime.sh launcher.
PlayTime statistics remain outside the managed package directory under /userdata/system/configs/playtime.
MagicX Zero 28 remains blocked: 640x480 layout code exists, but the tagged dynamic SDL ABI, accelerated renderer, and controller launch are not verified on that device.
